# Design

server/stores/rooms.ts is the store: RoomRecord {id, name, memberIds, leadOnly, archived, section, cwd, pinnedCwd, createdAt}, MAX_MEMBERS 8, create/patch/remove/removeMember/roomsFor/pinCwd over rooms.json, and addressees(text, members) for @-resolution in room order. The engine is in server/index.ts: enqueueRoomPost chains one dispatch loop per room and marks latecomers queued; postToRoomNow resolves reach (mentions, leadOnly, toAll, archived notices) and runs speakInTurn, which sorts by seniority ascending and awaits waitForIdle after each turn; relayMentions hands the room on after a turn with agentHops capped by MAX_AGENT_HOPS 3 and a per-room dispatching queue; leadOf picks the highest seniority with ties to the earliest member; roomBriefing injects the roster, the lead or member paragraph and the labelled 30-message transcript; activeRoom maps a task to its room so provider events land in the right thread. Teams: server/agents/teams.ts extractTeamPlan (MAX_HIRES 4, caps on every field) and the hire, scout, import and manifest routes. Client: src/components/rooms/RoomView.tsx (header with crown line, leadOnly toggle, stream and forum lenses, @ autocomplete, archive or delete sheet, desk field until pinned), NewRoomDialog.tsx (member picker capped at 8 with a live crown, team library, scout, import), TeamHireDialog.tsx (seats, names drawn from NAME_POOL, brief and desk), ForumLens.tsx over src/lib/threads.ts, TeamMap.tsx over src/lib/teamMap.ts; the reducer routes a message by threadId to the room whose id matches.
